reply.text: I'm sorry your neck is sore. That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I'd get it looked at before deciding what to train around it. Once they've cleared you, tell me what they say and what to avoid, and I'll build the training around it. I can also make the squat swap in your program now if you want it, though you should check with them first on whether squatting with a load on your back is the right call for a sore neck.
